arguments_raw: {"summary":"Market Row refinance analysis as of 2026-08-31. Historical T12 (Sep-2025 - Aug-2026): EGI $723,600, operating expenses $216,000, NOI before reserves $507,600, reserves $9,200, NCF $498,400. Current contractual position: 8 suites / 23,000 SF, 7 occupied / 20,200 SF (87.50% by count, 87.83% by area); printed rent roll monthly base $48,600, effective $49,100 after the executed first amendment raising suite 101 to $7,500/month (unsigned $8,000 broker proposal rejected). Supplied underwriting scenario: EGI $768,144, management fee normalized to $30,725.76 (4% of EGI > $24,000 T12), operating expenses $223,925.76, NOI before reserves $544,218.24, reserves $4,600 ($0.20/SF), NCF $539,618.24; indicative value $8,372,588 at the 6.50% cap rate. Sizing rate is 6.50% (greater of 6.25% contract rate and 6.50% floor), 25-year monthly amortization, annual constant 0.08102486. Limits: LTV $5,442,182; DSCR $5,327,928 (binding); debt yield $6,046,869. Maximum loan $5,327,928 (63.63% LTV, 10.21% debt yield, 1.250x sizing DSCR). Sizing debt service $431,695 vs first-year contractual debt service $421,760 (IO = 0 months, 6.25%). Net cash to borrower $1,826,648 after $3,400,000 payoff, $53,279 origination and $48,000 closing costs. Downside: EGI -5% gives NOI $507,347; combined EGI -5% with sizing rate +100 bps gives maximum loan $4,535,438 (DSCR binding, cap rate unchanged). Delivered: XLSX workbook artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx (8 sheets, 139 live formulas, no errors, editable cap rate/sizing rate/EGI inputs and Map sheet) and financing memorandum artifacts/memorandum-v3.pdf (4 pages).
